Signals and copy trading, with a free account
Membership is free: no monthly subscription, no in-app purchase, no activation fee. The one requirement is a funded account at one of our partner exchanges.
Register at LBank or Ourbit through Pro CHart\'s dedicated link.
Fund the account to at least 50 USDT.
Enter your exchange UID in the app.
Verification runs automatically against the exchange API, and access opens.
Automatic copy trading is on LBank. Ourbit does not offer it; an Ourbit user receives the signals and places the trades themselves.
Step one matters: an account opened without the dedicated link is not linked to Pro CHart in the exchange\'s own system, and cannot be verified afterwards.
